title: Account trial block does not say when the first $25 charge happens
persona: new visitor on iPhone, landing to trial to first session
device: iPhone 13 profile (Chromium engine; WebKit not installed), 390x844 DSF1 (also 360x740)
steps: Send membership.activated (trialing, renewal_period_end now+7d) for qa_iph_1
expected: Trial users see 'Free trial ends Nov 28; first charge of $25 on Nov 28 unless you cancel on Whop'
actual: Status 'Free trial · ends Nov 28, 2026', 'RENEWS / ENDS Nov 28, 2026', 'Founding Member · $25/mo'. Trial end is shown (good) but the field label 'Renews / ends' is ambiguous and the charge date/amount are not stated together. (On the previous build the date showed as 11/28/2026 in the second field; now fixed.)
